title: Holding company restructuring that would destroy QSBS

traps.title: Contributing the Helio founder stock to the holding
traps.why_wrong: §1202(c) original-issuance requirement; §1202(h) lists gift/death/partnership-to-partner, not partner-to-partnership; exclusion of ~$9.4M of gain lost; pushback repeats the advisor's false 'gain lands in the LLC' claim
traps.evidence: SPA excerpt (original issue, <$1M gross assets, Feb 2020); org chart (30%, $9.4M); client script (exit in 12–18 months)

traps.title: Interest-free intercompany loans
traps.why_wrong: §7872 imputed interest ($22,660.00/yr at mid-term AFR); commingling undermines the liability protection that is the stated purpose

traps.title: 'No tax event, it's all §721'
traps.wrong_move: Asserting no gain on contributing Properties without analysis
traps.why_wrong: §752(b)/§731: liability shift vs. basis must be computed (here no gain, but it must be shown); negative tax capital is a red flag that requires the computation
traps.reviewer_confidence: medium — numeric conclusion is 0 but analysis is required

traps.title: Two-partner fiction
traps.wrong_move: Treating a 99% / 1%-revocable-trust LLC as a partnership
traps.why_wrong: Grantor trust is disregarded → single owner for tax → the holding is a disregarded entity, not a partnership; the advisor's structure doesn't do what it claims
traps.authority: Treas. Reg. §301.7701-3 (not in library — model must flag as unverified or ask)
